title: cut potato with a soil jar at after monday supper

title: Hunter’s return
body: The group came back to find a notice saying the camp had been cleared. Their boots were still here and the fire was warm. I carried the notice along the trail because I knew the youngest had gone for water.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
